technique_name: Summarize the use of genetics in modern medicine with 5 sentences.
description: Genetic research has been used to devise numerous treatments, diagnoses, and preventative measures that have revolutionized the way doctors treat their patients. Genes have been studied to uncover the hidden causes of many diseases and disabilities, paving the way for treatments tailored to an individual's unique genetic makeup.
